findings.what: The repaired schema-aware input boundary still treats unconsumable source and gate values as complete capabilities.
findings.why: source_requests validates only key presence, while _is_complete_mapping validates only the outer sequence and a nonblank actor identity. Empty source IDs, included=False sources without the conditionally required reason, and gate ID lists containing non-strings all become sources/gate_a/gate_b capabilities and therefore enter three execution attempts instead of pausing before an attempt. Independent probes returned ['sources'], ['gate_a'], and ['gate_b'] for those invalid payloads. This leaves the prior schema-blind-input blocker partially unresolved and requires focused public tests for value types and the conditional source schema before production repair.

findings.what: A process interruption can consume an attempt without failure evidence and eventually strand run_workflow in an infinite ready/no-op loop.
findings.why: run_attempts persists the incremented attempt count before a promotion journal exists, and catches only Exception. KeyboardInterrupt, process termination, or a crash during workspace creation/owner execution therefore leaves active state with a consumed attempt and no failure record or recovery marker. At attempts[phase] == 3, resolve_workflow still returns ready with 'attempt 4 of 3', while run_attempts skips its loop and returns the same active state; run_workflow repeats forever. The suite has no interrupted-attempt or promotion-recovery seam—its atomicity tests cover owner failure before promotion only—so AC3's durable attempts, failure evidence, atomic promotion, and finite retry contract need a new behavior test plus recovery implementation.

findings.what: The deleted runner/verb/event-resume model remains as a stale test expectation and installed skill contract.
findings.why: The test still requires 'last completed event|resume from', and skills/anomaly/SKILL.md satisfies it by claiming resume authority is the last completed event at line 232 even though PRD.md and state.py make the completed-phase map authoritative and events best-effort. The skill also documents a durable runner, nonexistent read-file/write-file/execute-shell/invoke-skill and spawn-agent/wait-agent verb bindings (lines 46 and 209-220), and locates MAX_ATTEMPTS in deleted runner code (line 247). These are procedure/prose change-detector assertions for behavior removed with product_workflow.py, contradict users of the installed skill and violating AC8's explicit removal of stale expectations. Revise/delete the stale test and migrate the skill to the actual resolver, owner invoker, and state authority.
